questions.question_bn: Charges +Q at x=0, −2Q at x=18 m। between charges potential zero point-এর x কত?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Equal distances-এ harmonic mean 2v₁v₂/(v₁+v₂)=4×(8)/3। arithmetic mean শুধু equal times-এ।

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Orthogonal resultant R=√((3×(11))²+(4×(11))²)=5×(11)। সাধারণ যোগে 7×(11) ভুল।

questions.question_bn: H₂SO₄0.10M,150 mL পুরো neutralise করতে NaOH 0.20M কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Acidmoles 0.1·10nmmol=nmmol,base 2nmmol লাগে। V=2×(15)/0.2=10nmL; acid capacity 2explicit।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=22M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(22)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((22)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=7 mol,H₂=14 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(7))/3,availableN₂(7) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(7)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=11D make 120°। net dipole কত D?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic alkane C6H14 complete combustion-এ 1 mol fuel-এর O₂ requirement কত mol?

questions.question_bn: Fe₂O₃+3CO→2Fe+3CO₂। Fe₂O₃amount 5 mol complete conversion। CO₂mol কত?

questions.question_bn: 1400 mL0.20MNaOH; MNaOH 40g/mol। solutemass কত g?

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 68mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 17mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=4P₀ হলে concentration কত?

questions.question_bn: Rate=k[A]²[B]। [A] 14 গুণ,[B] half হলে rate ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Rate factor=((14))²×(½)=(14)²/2। coefficient/stoichiometry দিয়ে order replace করা যাবে না।

questions.question_bn: Ore160g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?

questions.question_bn: Sample 3 mol diene (2C=C per molecule), complete Br₂ addition। Br₂ mole required কত?

questions.question_bn: (NH₄)₂SO₄ sample 1452g। Nmass কত g? N14,H1,S32,O16

questions.question_bn: C6H10O molecular formula। degree of unsaturation কত?

questions.question_bn: Bleach sample 16 mol OCl⁻ acidic iodometry-তে I₂ কত mol মুক্ত করে? OCl⁻+2I⁻+2H⁺→I₂+Cl⁻+H₂O
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Balanced reaction অনুযায়ী OCl⁻:I₂=1:1। iodide coefficient 2 হলেও iodine molecules (16) mol; redox electron balance 2।

questions.question_bn: CH₄combustionreleases 890kJ/mol; amount 30 mol,burnerefficiency 80%। useful heat কত kJ?

questions.question_bn: Diluted water initial DO8mg/L, after 5days 6mg/L; sample fraction 1/23, blank correction 0। BOD₅ কত mg/L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। DO depletion=2mg/L in diluted mixture। Original sample BOD=(DOinitial−DOfinal)/fraction=2nmg/L।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=6×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((6)×10⁻²)=(1/(6))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: 6 mol monohydric alcohol excess Na-এর সঙ্গে react। H₂ produced কত mol?

questions.question_bn: Water Ca²⁺ 12mmol। soap RCOO⁻ stoichiometric precipitate Ca(RCOO)₂ হলে soap anion কত mmol consumed?

questions.question_bn: Same charge passes Ag⁺ ও Cu²⁺ cellsseries। depositedmoles Ag=15। Cumoles কত?

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 27×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?

questions.question_bn: 1500g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=258.3L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?

questions.question_bn: এক fat molecule-এ 24 C=C bond।1 mol fat fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu। charge 12F passes,current efficiency 100%,MCu64। depositedmass কত g?

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻7M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(7)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: Element isotopes masses 36 ও 38u, abundance 75% ও 25%। relative atomic mass কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Weighted mean 0.75((16)+20)+0.25((16)+22)=(16)+20.5u। সমান average (16)+21 abundance উপেক্ষা করে।
